hunks.baseline: It was true. The countless battles I had fought in the Murim had always ended in one of two ways.
hunks.sol: It was true. The countless battles I had fought in Murim had always ended in one of two ways.

hunks.baseline: Except for the Blood Lord, who had escaped even after losing an arm, the result had always been one or the other—and it had never been me who fell.
hunks.sol: Except for the Blood Lord, who had escaped even after losing an arm, the outcome had always been one or the other—and it had never been me who fell.

hunks.baseline: To bring down the monster before me, I had to do whatever it took, without caring about the means.
hunks.sol: To bring down the monster before me, I had to do whatever it took, by any means necessary.

hunks.baseline: I had lived as a Hunter for seven solid years, yet without realizing it, I had been pretending to be some hidebound martial artist. I couldn’t help letting out a quiet laugh at myself.
hunks.sol: I had lived as a Hunter for seven solid years, yet without realizing it, I had been pretending to be some hidebound martial artist. I couldn’t help laughing quietly at myself.

hunks.baseline: Both were part of my identity. I was the one and only modern martial artist—and the Murim’s Hunter.
hunks.sol: Both were part of my identity. I was the one and only modern martial artist—and Murim’s Hunter.

hunks.baseline: At the indistinct boundary that had nearly been erased, I reminded myself of that fact once more.
hunks.sol: Standing once more on the blurred boundary between them, a line that had nearly faded away, I reminded myself of that fact.

hunks.baseline: It felt like I had awakened from a very long sleep. I landed lightly on the shore and let out a thunderous shout.
hunks.sol: It felt as though I had awakened from a very long sleep. I landed lightly on the shore and let out a thunderous shout.

hunks.sol: But what mattered was that I had survived and brought the bastard down. The fear I had felt while facing the Arch Lich had become experience, carved deep into my body and mind.

hunks.sol: But once that fear was stripped away, we could finally recognize something we had forgotten.

hunks.baseline: I kept my gaze fixed on its gleaming, pitch-black pupil and continued.

hunks.sol: But none of the billions of people who had survived the Great Cataclysm could have imagined that another raid was taking place somewhere beyond time and space, against a strange monster resembling a dragon.

hunks.sol: Nor could they have imagined that a familiar face stood at the center of it all.

hunks.sol: A solidly built figure bounded off fragments of flying rock and shot skyward.
